Headquarters: Remote, US

** Open to remote within the Central Time Zone only**

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

As a Strategic Solution Architect, Presales at JFrog's Strategic Solution Engineering Team, you will be on the front lines, working closely with our top Fortune 500 customers, guiding them on how to build robust software delivery processes. You will work with our sales, product & engineering, customer success and marketing teams to help customers understand the value of JFrog solutions from a technical and business perspective.

If you love working with brilliant people, being part of an energetic team, changing the world of software and you’ve got the technical skills, you might be the perfect Frog to join our Swamp! Come and help us to continue to lead the rapidly evolving space of DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps!

As a Strategic Solution Architect, Presales in JFrog you will... 

• Engage with JFrog’s most strategic customers to ensure their success in their DevSecOps journey leveraging JFrog’s products

• Partner with Sales account executives to build accounts strategy, activities and build long lasting trust relationships with assigned JFrog customers

• Educate customers (engineers and executives) on the JFrog platform fundamental capabilities and key value proposition across all the platform's broad set of capabilities

• Represent JFrog in customer and public events and conferences

• Work closely with Product & Engineering global organization to provide first hand feedback from the field and influence the Products features and roadmap based on insights gathered from customers

• Keep current with the latest technology trends related to the DevOps, DevSecOps, MLOps and IoT landscapes

• Collaborate with Customer Success and Marketing to broaden our customer engagements horizontally and vertically and increase the customers’ adoption of the JFrog Platform

• Build relationships with key decision makers, visiting customers on-site, and serving as a customer's trusted technical point of contact

To be a Strategic Solution Architect, Presales in JFrog you need...

• 10+ years experience in enterprise presales/solutions engineering for Fortune 500 / 100 accounts with multi million dollar deals

• Superb interpersonal, team playing, show and tell style, customer happiness obsession and “can do” attitude

• Extensive customer-facing experience in a software infrastructure enterprise presales role

• Docker, Kubernetes, CI, git , Artifactory, Build tools (maven, gradle, npm, docker etc.)

• Ability to build software delivery pipelines with Docker, npm, Java, Pypi etc. with various DevOps tools

• Knowledgeable of application security (AppSec)

• Hands-on experience in Linux - Mandatory

• Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure - AWS / Azure / GCP - Mandatory

• Experience with software development in scale, both on-premise and in the cloud

• Experience with Software Architecture design, product development, IT infrastructure a plus

• Ability to travel at least 50% throughout the US

• Uncompromising will to learn

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher education in Computer Science/Engineering Major is preferred

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

• Open to remote work for candidates outside a reasonable commuting distance to the Sunnyvale, Atlanta, or Seattle offices

• At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.

• This position has a base salary range between $195,000 to $215,000.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

• Additionally, this role is eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.

• This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

• JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

Online Data Analyst -Urdu/India

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of India's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools

• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources

• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning

• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations

• Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)

• Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

• Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments

• Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment

• Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision

• Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.

• Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Requirements:

• Professional fluency in English and Urdu (native or near-native proficiency required)

• Residency in India for the last 5 consecutive years

• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)

• Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability

• Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of India

• Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)

• Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

• Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview

• Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process

• Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)

• Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given

• Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Please be aware that you may be required to rate tasks that relate to data from other countries or territories where the same language is spoken. 

Service Rates 

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
